runtime.kind: x86_64 llvmpipe (software Vulkan, lavapipe ICD libvulkan_lvp.so)
runtime.shader_compiler: glslangValidator 12.0.0 (x86 dev box; M1 glslc not exercised per wave constraints)

defect.symptom: irfft with output [1, 16777216] (2^24 real elements) failed upstream test_fft_big_powers_of_two with the named refusal 'FFT output size is not implemented ... shape=[1,16777216]' (requal failure cluster real-fft-extract-output-size-cap).
defect.cause: The irfft extract kernel takes the real part of the full-length inverse transform one element per thread in a single x dispatch dimension. An output of 2^24 elements needs 65,536 workgroups of 256, one past the guaranteed 65,535 x-workgroup limit, so the host refused any output above 65,535 * 256 = 16,776,960 elements by name before dispatching.

change: overlay/mlx/backend/omarchy/shaders/fft_real_extract.comp: main() grid-strides over params.count with stride = gl_NumWorkGroups.x * gl_WorkGroupSize.x, the same convention fft_stage.comp adopted at 06116468.

overlay/mlx/backend/omarchy/primitives.cpp: the out.size() > 65535*256 named refusal before the FftRealF32 dispatch is deleted; the dispatch already went through compute_dispatch_group_count, which caps the single x dimension at the guaranteed limit while the grid-striding kernel covers any element count.

overlay/tests/omarchy/test_fft_ops.cpp: new case "rfft and irfft at 2^24 real elements cross the extract limit" - a real delta at element n-1 (inside the trailing 256-element window past 65,535*256) with the exact analytic half spectrum X[k] = e^(-2*pi*i*(n-1)*k/n), k = 0..n/2. rfftn is checked densely over the top 2048 bins plus every 4096th bin; irfftn of the same host-built spectrum must reproduce the delta, checked densely over the whole trailing window from 65,535*256 to n plus every 4096th element below it, tolerance 2e-4.

fft_family_audit.extract (fft_real_extract.comp): defective, fixed here (refusal removed, kernel grid-strides)
fft_family_audit.elementwise stages (fft_stage.comp via d: already grid-strided at 06116468; every twiddle, Bluestein a/b/pointwise/epilogue, permute, real-promote and half-synthesis edge dispatch routes through that one helper - no size gate
fft_family_audit.radix-2 passes (fft_c2c.comp via dispatc: one workgroup per transform, transform count split across x/y/z with flattened ids in the kernel and a named refusal only past 65535^3 transforms - untouched
fft_family_audit.Bluestein batch gate (run_fft_bluestein): conv_elements > 0x7ffffff refusal is an int-backed Shape bound, not a workgroup-count gate - kept
fft_family_audit.remaining 65535 references: only kMaxComputeGroupCountX itself in compute.h, which is the dispatch cap, not a kernel gate

test_cost.memory: the 2^24 case holds a 64 MiB real input vector plus device copy, a 64 MiB half spectrum (host and device), up to four full-length 128 MiB complex64 pipeline temporaries per direction, and a 128 MiB double readback for the irfft output; measured peak process RSS 1592 MiB (on llvmpipe device buffers share system RAM)
test_cost.time: one 2^24 rfft plus one 2^24 irfft per suite run; the new case is ~74 s of the ~113 s fft_ops suite wall time on this box

limitations: Everything here ran only on this x86 box against llvmpipe; no M1 hardware run is claimed. Per AGENTS.md the M1's glslc accepts a narrower shader subset, so the M1 wheel build remains the parent's gate.

The red demonstration fails at the named refusal before any dispatch, so the silent-wrong-value failure mode of a non-grid-strided extract (trailing 256 outputs left unwritten, delta diff 1.0) is guarded only by construction plus the dense trailing-window assertions, not by an observed red of that mode.
Only omarchy_fft_ops_tests, omarchy_fft_general_tests, and omarchy_runtime_tests were run, per the wave contract; the project-wide battery is the parent's job.
